blocks.text: 39840 Old Yale Road Sumas Prairie Abbotsford V3G 1X7

parts.t: BIG VIEWS, TOTAL PRIVACY & 3.53 ACRES TO ENJOY! This 1,803 sq.ft. hillside property offers 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and an incredible valley outlook just 10 minutes from Hwy 1. The fully fenced acreage has been extensively cleared, creating plenty of usable space for animals, gardens, recreation and more. Inside, the home has been freshly painted and offers a practical family-friendly layout. An oversized 2-car garage provides excellent parking and storage. Complete with fenced pasture, septic system and 300 ft well, this is the perfect blend of peaceful country living, privacy and convenient highway access.

v: Private and extensively cleared acreage with usable space for animals, gardens, recreation and more.
Elevated hillside setting offering impressive valley views and excellent privacy.
4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and approximately 1,803 sq ft with a practical family-friendly layout.
Oversized double garage, RV parking, fenced pasture, septic system and well.
Newer home built in 2016 on acreage.
A2 agricultural zoning. Buyers should confirm permitted uses with the City of Abbotsford.
